objective: Increase qualified Google serving, query ownership, search-result clarity and click-through for the canonical Pictured Rocks planner by improving metadata and entity coherence without keyword stuffing, duplicate intent owners or repeated title churn.
principles: Metadata can improve relevance, entity understanding and search appearance, but it cannot substitute for useful page content.
The title and prominent page language are relevance signals; the meta description is treated primarily as a snippet and CTR lever.
Structured data must describe visible truth and may improve Google's understanding or search appearance, but rich results are never assumed or guaranteed.
The canonical title is frozen long enough to measure before another title experiment is attempted.

hardVetoes: canonical response is noindex or blocked from indexing
title or H1 no longer clearly names Pictured Rocks
structured data claims features, ratings, prices, reviews or facts not visible and true on the page
another owned page is deliberately optimized to own the same generic Pictured Rocks planner/map/itinerary intent

rubric.crawl_canonical_integrity: Full credit only when the canonical is 200, indexable, self-canonical, sitemap-listed and the lab source remains noindex.
rubric.query_title_h1_alignment: Full credit when Pictured Rocks + planner intent is explicit and map/itinerary/weather concepts are represented naturally across title, H1 and prominent visible copy without repetition.
rubric.subdomain_site_identity: Full credit when the root subdomain declares a consistent WebSite name, alternate name, application name and og:site_name specific to this tool.
rubric.entity_graph_coherence: Full credit when WebSite -> WebPage -> WebApplication -> TouristDestination -> Person relationships use stable @id links and describe the same canonical URL.
rubric.snippet_click_promise: Full credit when the description accurately previews the map, live conditions, mode comparison and itinerary output in human language.
rubric.preferred_image_consistency: Full credit when primaryImageOfPage, WebApplication image, og:image and Twitter image resolve to the same crawlable representative image.
rubric.internal_anchor_reinforcement: Full credit when relevant owned pages link to the canonical with descriptive anchors while avoiding duplicate generic-intent optimization.
rubric.experiment_isolation_and_measurement: Full credit when title/description variants are frozen during measurement windows and changes are annotated against settled GSC data.

notes.crawl_canonical_integrity: Strong: indexed, self-canonical and dedicated sitemap present.
notes.query_title_h1_alignment: Strong after the September 28 search-acquisition rewrite.
notes.subdomain_site_identity: Weakest metadata dimension: og:site_name and WebPage isPartOf identified the broader Chris Izworski site rather than the Pictured Rocks subdomain as its own site identity.
notes.entity_graph_coherence: Partial: the WebApplication existed but had no stable @id linking it to the canonical WebPage graph.
notes.measurement: Settled GSC data still predates the September 28 rebuilt planner, so it cannot be used to judge the new title yet.

requiredMetadataState: WebSite node for https://picturedrocks.chrisizworski.com/ named Pictured Rocks Trip Planner
alternateName includes Pictured Rocks Planner and the lowercase subdomain as fallback
og:site_name and application-name match the subdomain site identity
WebPage isPartOf points to the subdomain WebSite node
WebPage mainEntity points to the WebApplication node
WebApplication has a stable #app @id and truthful featureList
WebPage/app/destination/author/image nodes are connected by @id rather than floating duplicate entities
title and description remain frozen during the first measurement window

currentMetadataVariant.title: Pictured Rocks Trip Planner 2026: Map, Itinerary & Weather
currentMetadataVariant.description: Plan Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore with an interactive map, current weather and access, best stops, boat vs. hike choices, and 1- or 2-day itineraries.
currentMetadataVariant.h1: Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore Trip Planner
currentMetadataVariant.freezeRule: Do not alter the title or description again until enough settled post-release Search Console data exists to compare query assignment and CTR.

observedCompetitorPatterns: NPS owns authoritative Plan Your Visit and Maps intent.
Commercial competitors explicitly target one-day itinerary and first-time visitor intent.
The Pictured Rocks planner differentiator is combining map + current conditions + mode choice + personalized itinerary on one page.
targetQueryFamilies: things to do at pictured rocks

observedCanonicalQueryRows: kayaking pictured rocks without a guide
gscBaseline.interpretation: This is a pre-treatment baseline. The rebuilt canonical and metadata treatment launched after the settled reporting window, so no ranking conclusion should be drawn from these numbers yet.

actions: Declare the Pictured Rocks subdomain as its own WebSite entity.
Align WebSite name, application-name and Open Graph site name.
Connect WebPage, WebApplication, TouristDestination, Person and preferred ImageObject using stable @id values.
Keep the September 28 title, description and H1 unchanged while Google recrawls and assigns queries.
Do not add meta-keyword-style repetition to visible or hidden metadata.
Measure number of distinct target-query families receiving impressions.
Measure total impressions and average position for planner/map/itinerary queries.
Only evaluate CTR after the page is receiving enough impressions at comparable positions.

plan.trigger: After a minimum 14 settled post-release days, if Google still does not assign map/itinerary/planner queries despite healthy indexing.
plan.candidate: Pictured Rocks Map & Trip Planner 2026 | 1–2 Day Itineraries
plan.rule: Change one major snippet variable at a time, annotate the date, and compare equivalent settled windows.

plan.trigger: If text impressions grow but search appearance remains weak.
actions: Replace the remote preferred image with a stable first-party 1200px+ representative image if one is available.
Keep primaryImageOfPage, WebApplication image, og:image and Twitter image identical.

day7.goal: Google begins assigning multiple relevant query families to the canonical planner.
day7.pass: At least 3 target-query families show impressions on the canonical after the first complete settled post-release days.

day14.pass: At least 5 target-query families show impressions, with at least one of planner/map/itinerary on the canonical and no renewed generic cannibalization from the weekend guide.

day28.goal: Meaningful expansion in qualified search serving.
day28.pass: Impressions materially exceed the pre-treatment 21-impression baseline, target-query diversity rises, and average position improves or remains competitive while query breadth expands.

doNotOptimizeTo: raw CTR before sufficient impressions and comparable positions
search-result title appearance before Google has recrawled the new metadata
keyword density or hidden keyword lists
